race.title: Make The Move To Midnite Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
race.verdict: CELESTIAL FIRE showed plenty to work on amidst greenness when third at Redcar back in the spring and with improvement likely now stepped up in trip, Archie Watson's filly earns the vote over Hoya Bella , who is bred for longer trips but has shaped promisingly in both starts to date. Classic Bellini can edge out Wadima for minor honours. CELESTIAL FIRE (IRE) HOYA BELLA CLASSIC BELLINI
